source: scaffold written by hand in plan 3 Tasks 8 and 10, without reading any paper: the types, the ontology seed, the names protocol (Task 8, SciREX) and the values protocol (Task 10, SciLead); words.yaml holds only the GLiNER labels of the four name types

files.pack.yaml: the four SciREX name types (Method, Dataset, Task, Metric) and a measured value (Task 10, SciLead); metric, dataset and measurement keep the rag pack's prefixes
files.words.yaml: GLiNER labels only (the type names as plain labels); the rest is empty until the drafting helper runs
files.ontology.ttl: hand-written from the CS-KG 2.0 specification (https://scholkg.kmi.open.ac.uk/cskg/ontology), no download
files.protocols/values.yaml: Task 10 (F9): measured values linked to their method, dataset and metric, for the SciLead check; LLM extractor only (the number extractors need the pack's metric words)

owed: words.yaml drafted by a fresh helper (Claude via the exchange model, docs/claude-writer.md) from the text of 10 SciREX train-split papers only (never the test split, any gold, or SciLead); the 10 doc_ids and the helper's log are recorded here
freeze: the pack (both protocols) is frozen under tag ev4-ml-pack before any scored run, after the helper's words land (F9: frozen after Task 10, not Task 8)

ontology.note: no metric classes: the pack has no canonical metrics yet

known_limits: metric has no canonical_field: the SciLead scorer matches a metric by its cleaned name or its name group (names.json), so no canonical metric list is needed; one would be added with the words, before the freeze

ontology.roles maps one class per role (pack format), so the task type takes the context role's cskg:Material, not cskg:Task; harmless for both checks: names.yaml has no links and values.yaml links no measurement to a task
